timeline_disposition.reason: Saadia Gaon (882–942) is a securely historical Jewish philosopher, theologian and rabbi. SEP records his birth in Fayyum in Egypt, later rabbinic leadership at the Sura Academy, and death in Baghdad. This transregional religious and intellectual career is not reduced to one canonical polity-bound Activity rail.

sources.title: Saadya [Saadiah] — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: SEP records Saadya Gaon (882–942), born in Fayyum in Upper Egypt and deceased in Baghdad, as a theologian, philosopher and rabbi whose career included leadership at the Sura Academy.
